# Rizwan Zafar — Payments Product Executive

> Personal site of Rizwan Zafar, a payments product executive based in Dubai building regulated payment infrastructure across emerging markets — $1B+ GTV, 25M+ monthly transactions.

Rizwan is Chief Product Officer at Simpaisa and writes about payment infrastructure, cross-border payments, settlement, KYC/KYB, fraud and risk, and emerging-markets fintech product strategy.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, positioning, selected work and metrics.
- [About](/about): Background from engineering to payments leadership, plus recommendations.
- [Product Work](/product-work): Case studies in regulated payments infrastructure at $1B+ GTV scale.
- [Blog](/blog): Notes on payments, product and emerging markets.
- [Resume](/resume): Executive resume — payments product, infrastructure and risk.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch about senior payments roles or advisory work.
